The central application has not responded for a few minutes.
The central application stopped responding several minutes ago and still does not respond. Report that continuing symptom.
Sinds enkele minuten marks a continuing interval. Dutch present reageert ... niet corresponds to English has not responded; no Dutch perfect auxiliary is missing.
Two teams have independently reported the interruption.
During your incident update to colleagues, two teams independently reported the interruption. Tell support about that corroboration.
Hebben gemeld forms the perfect with plural twee teams. Onafhankelijk describes the reports as independent; it does not identify the cause.
Who receives the first incident report?
You need to know who receives the initial incident report. Ask for that recipient.
Wie is itself the question subject of ontvangt. De eerste incidentmelding is the object received; no extra subject follows the finite verb.
A cause has not been established yet.
Investigators have not established a cause yet. State that limit on the investigation.
Nog niet means not yet. Is vastgesteld is passive perfect here; it reports an unestablished cause without claiming that the incident has no cause.
The incident affects the external connections.
During your incident update to colleagues, the incident affects external connections. Tell support which connections are affected.
Raakt means affects here rather than physically touches. Het incident is singular and de externe verbindingen is the plural object.
We must preserve the original error text.
Your team must retain the original error text. State that evidence-preservation requirement.
Moeten is finite with we; bewaren is an infinitive without te. Oorspronkelijke identifies the original wording rather than an edited summary.
I have alerted the incident coordinator.
During your incident update to colleagues, you already alerted the incident coordinator. Report that completed action.
Heb gewaarschuwd is perfect. De incidentcoördinator is the person alerted, not the sentence's subject; the subject is ik.
S=De collega|V=bevestigt|G=dat de dienst niet bereikbaar is.
The colleague confirms that the service is unreachable.
A colleague has confirmed that the service is unreachable. Attribute the confirmation to that colleague.
Bevestigt agrees with de collega. Dat introduces the confirmed proposition and its finite is comes at the end; niet negates bereikbaar.
You need the observation that was recorded earliest. Ask which observation it was.
Welke waarneming is the question subject. Is vastgelegd is passive perfect; als eerste identifies recording order rather than the first person recording it.
The extent is not fully known yet.
The incident's full extent is not yet known. Qualify the available scope information.
Nog niet volledig means not fully yet. It allows some knowledge of the extent, rather than claiming nothing whatsoever is known.
This number refers to the central incident report.
A number in the update points to the central incident record. Explain what that number refers to.
Dit matches singular het nummer. Verwijzen takes naar for its reference; de centrale incidentmelding is the record being referred to.
Add new observations to the same incident.
New observations belong in the same incident record. Tell a colleague to add them there.
Toevoegen splits as imperative voeg ... toe. Aan hetzelfde incident names the destination; hetzelfde refers to singular het incident.
Most users can work again, although recovery for everyone is not confirmed. Report that limited recovery.
Kunnen is finite with plural de meeste gebruikers; werken stays infinitive. De meeste means most, not all, and weer means again.
During your incident update to colleagues, external access remains blocked. Tell colleagues about that remaining restriction.
Nog means still here. Geblokkeerd describes the current blocked state after is; the sentence contains no niet and does not state that access has recovered.
We have confirmed two more affected sites.
Your team confirmed two additional affected sites. Add those sites to the incident update.
Hebben bevestigd is perfect. Nog twee means two more; it adds to the confirmed count without stating the original total.
During your incident update to colleagues, some functions have become available again. Ask which ones.
Welke functies is the plural question subject, with zijn. Weer beschikbaar means available again; no extra subject or infinitive is needed.
The number of new reports remains the same.
The count of new reports has not changed. Describe that unchanged volume.
The head of the subject is singular aantal, so blijft is singular despite plural meldingen. Gelijk is the unchanged state after blijft.
I pass on that the check is still ongoing.
A check is still in progress. Say that you are passing on that status.
Doorgeven splits as geef ... door. Dat introduces the relayed information, and nog loopt at its end means the check continues.
We still need to process the backlog.
Service has recovered, but your team still needs to process the backlog. State that remaining work.
Moeten expresses necessity with plural we, followed by bare infinitive verwerken. Nog shows that backlog processing remains to be done.
The latest check has not shown a new interruption.
The latest check found no new interruption. Report only that limited finding.
Heeft aangetoond is perfect. Geen nieuwe onderbreking negates an indefinite interruption; this limited finding is not proof of permanent recovery.
The recovery time is still an expectation, not a confirmation.
The recovery time is still provisional rather than confirmed. Explain that distinction.
Nog een verwachting describes the continuing estimate. Geen bevestiging contrasts it with confirmation; these are noun complements after is, not objects.
When does the next assessment follow?
Colleagues need to know when the next assessment is scheduled. Ask for that time.
Wanneer asks for time, followed by finite volgt and subject de volgende beoordeling. Volgt means comes next here, not following a person. A natural English rendering is: When is the next assessment?
Internal telephone service is working at all sites again.
Internal telephone service works again at every site. Report recovery for that particular service.
Weer means again and op alle locaties covers every site. The subject is de interne telefonie; the sentence does not assert recovery of every other service.
If the situation changes, we update the report.
Your team updates the report whenever the situation changes. Describe that condition for updating it.
Als introduces the condition. Its clause precedes main-clause werken we; bijwerken splits as werken ... bij around the object de melding.
Second-line support has received the report.
Second-line support received the report, but accepted ownership is unconfirmed. Report receipt only.
Heeft ontvangen is perfect with de tweede lijn as subject. Ontvangen means received; receipt does not automatically mean responsibility was taken over.
Which additional data does the specialist need?
A specialist needs more information before proceeding. Ask which additional details are required.
Welke extra gegevens is the fronted object. De specialist is singular with heeft; heeft ... nodig means needs, not a perfect construction.
We can explain the observations in a short call.
Your team can explain its observations in a short call. Offer that briefing.
Kunnen is finite with we and toelichten remains a joined infinitive. In een kort gesprek describes the form of the briefing rather than its clock time.
I remain the contact person until confirmation.
Takeover has not been confirmed, so you remain the contact person until then. State your role.
Blijf describes the continuing role, with het aanspreekpunt as a noun complement. Tot de bevestiging sets its endpoint.
The cause has not been proven by this test.
A test has been run, but it does not establish the cause. Explain the limit of that evidence.
Is bewezen is passive perfect. Door deze test names the proposed evidence, not the actor of the main sentence; niet rejects proof by this test.
We have discussed the severity with the coordinator.
Your team discussed the severity with the coordinator. Report that completed discussion.
Hebben besproken forms the perfect. Met de coördinator names the discussion partner; discussing severity does not assert that escalation is approved.
Can you confirm the takeover in the ticket?
A colleague needs to confirm accepting ownership in the ticket. Ask them informally to record that confirmation.
Kun precedes subject je. In het ticket gives the recording location; bevestigen stays infinitive, and the request is not completed confirmation.
S=Ik|V=vermeld|G=dat de omweg slechts tijdelijk werkt.
I mention that the workaround only works temporarily.
You are briefing a specialist on a workaround that only helps temporarily. State the limitation you are including.
Dat introduces what you mention. Slechts tijdelijk limits the duration of werkt; it does not mean the workaround is useless while active.
To which team does the next question go?
You do not know which team should receive the next question. Ask for its destination.
Naar welk team is the complete fronted question phrase. Gaat precedes subject de volgende vraag; naar gives the question's destination.
The specialist is now investigating the connection.
During your incident update to colleagues, the specialist is currently investigating the connection. Report the activity underway.
Onderzoekt agrees with singular de specialist. Nu means now; this present investigation is distinct from a completed diagnosis.
Keep the original report with the escalation.
The original report must remain with the escalation. Tell a colleague to retain it.
Bewaar is an imperative without an expressed subject. De oorspronkelijke melding is its object; bij de escalatie identifies the associated record or process.
G=Als niemand de overname bevestigt,|V=volg|S=ik|O=de melding|PART=op.
If nobody confirms takeover, I follow up the report.
If nobody confirms takeover, you will follow up the report. State that fallback action.
Niemand is singular with bevestigt. The fronted condition is followed by main-clause volg ik; opvolgen splits as volg ... op.
We can temporarily record requests manually.
The usual request system is unavailable, but your team can record requests manually for now. Offer that workaround.
Kunnen gives an available option. Tijdelijk limits duration, handmatig describes the method, and noteren stays infinitive without te.
The temporary route does not work for large files.
During your incident update to colleagues, the temporary transfer route cannot handle large files. Explain that limitation.
Niet negates werkt for the scope voor grote bestanden. Voor identifies the file category here, not a time or deadline.
The administrator has approved the workaround.
During your incident update to colleagues, the administrator approved the workaround. Report the completed approval.
Heeft goedgekeurd is the perfect of separable goedkeuren. De beheerder is the approving subject; de omweg is the approved object.
A workaround is in use, but the original ticket remains open. State that tracking status.
Blijft describes continuation and open is a predicate adjective. The sentence does not say that the original ticket was deleted or resolved.
Who checks the manually entered data?
Someone must verify the data entered by hand. Ask who checks it.
Wie is the question subject. Handmatig describes ingevoerde, which modifies gegevens: the data was entered manually and now needs checking.
S=Ik|V=meld|G=dat de omweg extra fouten kan veroorzaken.
I report that the workaround may cause extra errors.
The workaround could introduce additional errors. State the risk you are reporting.
Dat introduces the reported possibility. Kan veroorzaken is its final modal-infinitive group; kan expresses a risk rather than a certain future outcome.
Temporary processing is slower than normal.
During your incident update to colleagues, temporary processing is slower than the normal method. Compare their speeds.
Langzamer is a comparative and takes dan. Normaal is the reference standard; the comparison concerns speed rather than accuracy.
We must check the data entered afterwards.
During your incident update to colleagues, your team must verify data entered afterwards. State that required check.
Moeten requires infinitive controleren without te. Achteraf modifies ingevoerde and identifies data entered later, not necessarily data already checked.
I have shared the temporary instructions with the team.
You shared the temporary instruction with the team. Report that completed communication.

Heb gedeeld is perfect and met het team names the recipients. De tijdelijke instructie can mean one instruction or instruction document, rendered collectively as instructions in the historical English.
The cause remains unknown despite the workaround.
The workaround helps, but the cause remains unknown. Explain that knowledge has not improved despite the workaround.
Ondanks de omweg expresses concession, not time. Onbekend is the continuing state after blijft; success of a workaround does not identify a cause.
When do we reassess the workaround?
The workaround will need another assessment. Ask when your team will reassess it.
Wanneer asks for the review time. Beoordelen agrees with plural we, and opnieuw means again; this question does not say review is complete.
G=Als de omweg niet meer werkt,|V=melden|S=we|O=dat|A=meteen.
If the workaround stops working, we report it immediately.
Your team must immediately report it if the workaround stops working. State that reporting condition.
Niet meer means no longer. The fronted als-clause is followed by main-clause melden we; dat refers back to the workaround's failure.
The night shift gets the same incident reference.
The night shift should use the same incident reference. Explain which reference they receive.
Krijgt agrees with singular de nachtdienst. Dezelfde preserves the incident reference across shifts rather than creating a new incident.
I have added the contact details to the report.
You added contact details to the report. Tell the next shift what you included.
Heb gezet is perfect. Bij de melding identifies where the contactgegevens have been added; the sentence reports documentation, not accepted takeover.
A handover leaves some checks unfinished. Ask which checks are still needed.
Welke controles is the plural question subject and takes zijn. Nodig is an adjective meaning needed, and nog marks the remaining need.
S=Een verstuurd bericht|V=is|C=nog geen bevestigde overdracht.
A sent message is not a confirmed handover yet.
A colleague assumes sending the handover message completes the transfer. Explain why a sent message is not confirmed handover yet.
Een verstuurd bericht is singular. Nog geen negates a confirmed handover so far; verstuurd and bevestigde modify the two nouns.
We must also mention the temporary solution.
Your team must also tell the next shift about the temporary solution. State that added handover requirement.
Moeten takes bare infinitive vermelden. Ook means also and adds the temporary solution to what must be mentioned; it does not indicate a time.
S=De laatste test|V=staat|PP=met tijdstip|L=in het ticket.
The latest test is in the ticket with its time.
The ticket includes the latest test and its time. Tell the next shift where that record is.
Staat refers to a recorded test being listed. Met tijdstip says its time is included; in het ticket locates the record.
S=Ik|V=vraag|G=of de volgende ploeg de afspraak begrijpt.
I ask whether the next shift understands the agreement.
You are asking whether the next shift understands the agreement. Describe that understanding check.
Of means whether, not or. The embedded subject de volgende ploeg is singular with begrijpt at the end; understanding is distinct from receiving a message.
The late shift has taken over responsibility.
During your incident update to colleagues, the late shift has accepted responsibility. Report that completed takeover.
Heeft overgenomen is perfect. De late dienst is the receiving shift, and de verantwoordelijkheid is the object taken over.
Who is available after eight o'clock?
You need a reachable contact after eight o'clock. Ask who is available then.
Wie is the question subject and na acht uur means after eight. Bereikbaar means reachable or contactable in this handover context.
Also mention the checks that yielded no result.
Checks that produced no useful result should still appear in the handover. Tell a colleague to mention them too.
Vermeld is an imperative, and ook adds these checks to the report. Zonder resultaat describes the checks; it does not mean they were never performed.
S=De volgende ploeg|V=hoeft|O=de eerste test|NEG=niet|TE=te herhalen.
The next shift does not have to repeat the first test.
The first test has already been done and need not be repeated by the next shift. Explain that lack of necessity.
Hoeft ... niet te herhalen means does not have to repeat. It removes an obligation, rather than forbidding repetition; herhalen follows te here.
G=Als er nieuwe meldingen komen,|V=voegt|S=de avonddienst|O=die|PART=toe.
If new reports arrive, the evening shift adds them.
New reports may arrive after handover, and the evening shift will add them. State that conditional responsibility.
The als-clause is the first constituent. Voegt agrees with singular de avonddienst and the particle of toevoegen is toe; die refers to plural nieuwe meldingen.
The user receives a closure message after the check.
The user will receive a closure message after the check. Explain that order of communication.
Na de controle means after the check. Krijgt is present with a future reading in this planned workflow; een afsluitbericht is what the user receives.
Which action remains outstanding after recovery?
Some work may remain after service recovery. Ask which action remains outstanding.
Welke actie is the question subject. Blijft takes bare infinitive openstaan, which stays joined here; na herstel identifies the stage after recovery.
We have revoked the temporary access again.
Your team has withdrawn the temporary access again. Report that completed permission cleanup.
Hebben ingetrokken is perfect with separable intrekken. Weer means again in this historical model; de tijdelijke toegang is what has been revoked.
The root-cause analysis is not finished yet.
Service is back, but the root-cause analysis is unfinished. State that remaining analysis status.
Nog niet klaar means not finished yet. Klaar is an adjective after is, not a participle reporting completed work.
The owner must plan the follow-up action before Friday.
The owner must plan the follow-up action before Friday. Give that planning deadline.
Moet takes bare infinitive plannen. Voor vrijdag is a deadline for planning the action, not necessarily for performing it.
S=Ik|V=meld|G=dat alle getroffen teams het herstel hebben bevestigd.
I report that all affected teams have confirmed recovery.
Every affected team has confirmed recovery. Report that complete set of confirmations.
Dat introduces the reported proposition. Alle getroffen teams is plural with hebben bevestigd; the perfect group reports completed confirmations.
The closure refers to the outstanding follow-up task.
The incident closure links to an outstanding follow-up task. Explain that remaining-work reference.
Verwijzen takes naar. De openstaande vervolgtaak is the task referred to; linking it at closure does not claim it is already completed.
Can we close the incident after this check?
A check is about to establish whether closure is possible afterwards. Ask whether your team can close the incident after that check.
Kunnen precedes we in the question and afsluiten stays infinitive. Na deze controle means after this check; the question does not itself authorise closure.
The incident coordinator has confirmed closure.
During your incident update to colleagues, the incident coordinator confirmed closure. Report that completed confirmation.
Heeft bevestigd forms the perfect with singular de incidentcoördinator. De afsluiting is what was confirmed, not the sentence's subject.
Who checks whether the problem returns?
Someone needs to monitor whether the problem recurs. Ask who performs that check.
Wie is the main question subject. Of introduces whether the problem returns; terugkomt stays joined at the embedded clause's end.
S=Een herstelde dienst|V=is|C=geen bewijs dat de oorzaak bekend is.
A restored service is not proof that the cause is known.
A colleague assumes restored service means its cause is known. Explain why recovery is not proof of that.
Geen bewijs negates an indefinite proof. Dat introduces the proposition for which proof is absent; de oorzaak is singular with final is.
G=Als de storing terugkomt,|V=verwijzen|S=we|PP=naar dit incident.
If the disruption returns, we refer to this incident.
The disruption may recur, and your team will refer to this incident if it does. State that linking rule.
The fronted als-clause ends in terugkomt. Main-clause verwijzen we follows it; naar dit incident names the record to refer to.
